NEW PROGRESSIVE PARTY (NPP)
A freer, fairer Caprica.
Conversation guide | 2068

OUR SHARED PURPOSE
A country that works for its people. A future we build together.

START WITH WHAT MATTERS
Ask what would make the biggest difference in someone's community. Listen, then connect the conversation to a specific policy. Refer to the full manifesto for detail and do not present proposals as achievements.

HOMES
Increase supply through planning reform, retain safety and quality standards, and introduce a progressive tax from the third residential property onward. The manifesto favours expanding supply over rent control.

PUBLIC SERVICES
Strengthen publicly administered healthcare and universally accessible, publicly funded education. Raise teacher salaries and invest in regional access to quality services.

CONNECTION
Build high-speed rail linking every state capital and better rural-to-urban transit connections.

CLEAN ENERGY
Develop nuclear and renewable energy, introduce an emissions cap-and-permit system and establish a national green investment bank.

DEMOCRATIC REFORM
Convene a constitutional convention for a Third Republic. Require public asset declarations from officials and ministers, and protect judicial independence.

EQUAL DIGNITY
Enforce equality protections and equal pay, recognise diverse family structures, and expand targeted support for people in need.

KEEP THE MESSAGE CONSISTENT
Party name: New Progressive Party
Short name: NPP
Shared line: A freer, fairer Caprica.
Use the supplied NPP logo. Link people to the original manifesto for the complete platform. This guide is a summary, not a replacement for the manifesto.

SOURCE
Progressive Caprica Manifesto (supplied PDF), provided as the policy source for the NPP website. The original PDF is available on the website.
